items.name: Himmeli
items.description: Himmeli is a traditional Finnish ornament. It is a type of mobile that connects thin straws with threads to form a geometric polyadron.
items.longDescription:
I would like to have a little lesson about Himmeri during daily classes and give them the opportunity to make it during drawing time so that all students can experience selling and buying what they made from J1.

The Himmeri for the exhibition will be made with the executive committee and everyone in the class. On the whiteboard, we display a video that summarizes the meaning, culture, and our activities of Himeri, so that customers can know more about Himmeri. The content of the video explains the self-introduction of the members, the traditions and culture of Himmeri, and where the money goes. And I will explain in a fun and easy-to-understand way what kind of activities the donation organization is doing and what kind of people it will help! As for the types of hinmeri to be sold, there are three types: for hanging from above, for desk use, and small hinmeri in the shape of a keychain. The keychain type is like a workshop, so that you can decide the color, design, and shape of the hinge. Make the real thing in advance and place it at the cash register, and when you place the box or a piece of paper with the design written on it, you can get the design you brought to the cash register.

items.name: ~A Challenge from the Phantom Thief M~ Reclaim the Stolen Sun!
items.description: One day, the Phantom Thief M (Moon) stole the sun. With the light gone, all sorts of terrible things are happening on Earth. Reclaim the sun from the Phantom Thief M!
items.longDescription: In this project, the Phantom Thief M (Moon) and the Sun are linked to the theme of this year’s MIF, ‘Eclipse’. Furthermore, one of its attractions is that, whilst solving the quizzes, participants can also take a personality test, which leads to greater self-understanding and enables them to discover a new side to themselves.
items.scheduleNote: Held in Room 103 only during Day1 (10/31) morning and Day2 (11/1) afternoon; other times the room switches to another J2 project (not available all day).

items.name: Space Mitagora Talk
items.description: Complete Pitagora to save the destruction of earth with aliens and be a hero!
items.longDescription: This takes place in space where the earth is about to destruct. In order to save the earth, you have to complete Pitagora with your group mate. There, aliens will help you to save the earth with you. Like the actual turtle talk, an alien is going to ask for thoughts from each group. It's an interactive project that everyone can enjoy. Also, you can enjoy by thinking how to complete Pitagora with your group. Please give it a try to save the earth.
items.scheduleNote: Held in Room 102 only during Day1 (10/31) afternoon and Day2 (11/1) morning; other times the room switches to another J2 project (not available all day).

items.name: Life Lab 〜What Kind of Life Will You Choose?〜
items.description: Life Lab is an interactive game where you experience a life full of different choices. Choose your education, career, marriage, and more to experience your own unique and exciting life!
items.longDescription: “Life Lab” is an interactive life simulation game where you can experience that there is no single right answer in life. Participants make their own choices about education, careers, marriage, and other important life events. Each choice changes three scores: “Money,” “Experience,” and “Happiness.” At the end, participants look back on the life they create and think about what makes a happy life. Everyone’s choices and results will be different. Come and enjoy the game while thinking about your own values and the kind of life you want to live!
items.scheduleNote: Held in Room 105 only during Day1 (10/31) morning and Day2 (11/1) afternoon; other times the room switches to another J2 project (not available all day).

items.name: What is your true level of concentration?! ~Spot the Difference~
items.description: A spot-the-difference game with a twist. It’s a chance to test your attention to detail in everyday situations. Whether you’re confident in your skills or hoping for an upset, do come along and put your skills to the test!
items.longDescription:
How good are you paying attention to details?
People often fail to notice changes in areas they aren’t consciously focusing on.
In this activity, you'll take on a 'spot the difference' challenge featuring a rather unique twist!
Starting with a basic 'spot the difference' task, moving on to the main challenge, and finally revealing the secret at the end, this is an activity where you can experience the mysteries of the subconscious whilst having fun.
Age and educational background are irrelevant. Everyone, from children to adults, can enjoy it!
There's even an entertaining twist at the end where you get to add a 'new mistake' by yourself!
Whether you're confident in your powers of observation and want to put them to the test, or you're not so sure but are hoping for an upset, please do come along and join!
Can you spot the real changes?
items.scheduleNote: Held in Room 103 only during Day1 (10/31) afternoon and Day2 (11/1) morning; other times the room switches to another J2 project (not available all day).

items.name: Haunted Classroom
items.description: This is a murder mystery style workshop where visitors can test their cognitive abilities and problem solving skills. In some areas teamwork is required as well.
items.longDescription: We will ask visitors to solve murder mysteries through a series of quizzes. The room is decorated in hand crafted decorations made by students and LED lights so that visitors are able to enjoy the atmosphere and fully become the character of the detective when solving quizzes. All of the quizzes and the stories were thought of by the students and were a product of their team work. Please consider coming!
items.scheduleNote: Held in Room 104 only during Day1 (10/31) morning and Day2 (11/1) afternoon; other times the room switches to another J2 project (not available all day).

items.name: WORLD MARKET CHALLENGE 〜A Shopping Journey Around the World〜
items.description: Travel through five countries, shop for local specialties, and enjoy learning about world currencies and cultures through a fun, immersive market game!
items.longDescription:
You are a traveler exploring the world! Visit five countries—Japan, China, India, France, and the United States—and shop for specialties from each country. At each booth, product prices are shown in Japanese yen, and you will convert them into the local currency and shop to match your budget exactly. Once you make the correct purchase, you will receive a stamp in your passport! Collect all five stamps and make your way to the finish!

Each booth also features “Culture Cards” introducing local specialties, food culture, traditions, and other aspects of daily life. Through the game, you can have fun while learning about world currencies and the cultures of different countries.

Everyone who clears all five booths will receive a sticker as a souvenir! Enjoy the feeling of traveling around the world while learning about different cultures and currencies!
items.scheduleNote: Held in Room 104 only during Day1 (10/31) afternoon and Day2 (11/1) morning; other times the room switches to another J2 project (not available all day).

items.name: Midnight at the Whisker Manor
items.description: Two teams infiltrate Whisker Manor and search for treasure. The moment you reach the treasure, the curse of the house attacked the two groups. Which one can you escape?
items.longDescription: Two teams infiltrate Whisker Manor and challenge to solve the mystery, aiming for the treasure hidden in the mansion. The goal was to get the treasure before the opposing team. However, the moment you get the treasure, the curse on the mansion is activated. In order to escape from the cursed house, the two teams must work together to solve the mystery and escape from the curse that is chasing them. It is a project where you can enjoy puzzle solving, teamwork, and a sense of tension with a time limit.
items.scheduleNote: Held in Room 105 only during Day1 (10/31) afternoon and Day2 (11/1) morning; other times the room switches to another J2 project (not available all day).

items.name: J1 & J2 IC Fusion Projects
items.description: See how Mita students are trying to improve their school and community.
items.longDescription: J1 and J2 Academy students will be constructing displays detailing the progress of their fusion class projects. Please come see how far their hard work has taken them and offer any advice you think may help them.

items.name: Physical expression
items.description: Through plays, dances, and other forms of performance, each class will express the interesting aspects and changes of different periods in different countries, with each class connecting them to its own theme, while the entire grade works together as one.
items.longDescription:
Each class is in charge of a different country and time period, and we will express them while enjoying the global perspectives and sense of diversity unique to MITA students.
Class A will present a dramatic story set during the turbulent French Revolution, with all 44 students working together to create the performance! We hope you enjoy it!
Class B will tell a story about the friendship between two main characters and their classmates, set in a school in Japan during the Heisei era, expressing the unique atmosphere of the Heisei era!
Class C will present the charm of modern Korea and the challenge of pursuing dreams, with all 44 students working together as one! We hope you enjoy it!
Class D will present America in the latter half of the 20th century. We have worked hard to express the unique and fascinating aspects of America.
Class E will express the story of ancient Rome, from its beginning to its fall, through passionate battles and powerful performances, with all 37 students of Class E!
Class F will present a journey of two main characters and pirates, set in England during the Age of Exploration, with "courage" as its theme!
Please come and experience the physical performance filled with the charm of our entire grade!
items.ticketInfo:
Tickets are strictly required. Same-day tickets are also available.

Ticket Distribution Info
Day 1
Location: Ground
Time: From 1:20 PM

Day 2
Location: Ground
Time: From 10:10 AM

items.name: 2026 SLA Yes, Let’s Go to Hokuriku.
items.description: Welcome! This is a presentation about the projects’ outcomes in Fukui and Toyama that 3rd -year junior high students have done in September. We also sell local food and hold workshop. Please feel free to stop by !
items.longDescription: The 3rd-year junior high school students went to Fukui and Toyama as “Social Link Action” to solve local issues. Each student did projects that they had been thinking about from May in each place. We will present the outcomes of the projects and local attractions we only discovered by going there. The Fukui course is split into four areas , and the Toyama course is split into three areas. We will also screen videos made on site, hand out introduction pamphlets, sell collaborative food and hold workshops that use local products. Please feel free to come!

items.name: WAGAMAMA
items.description: Create Your Own Flavor! Serving waffles, churros & drinks with endless combinations ∞ Pack in what you love and build your custom combo today 😋🎶
items.longDescription:
The Business Seminar is bringing "New Cute" to life this year with a wide range of unique menu concepts! Waffles, churros, and drinks—all lined up and ready for you‼️
Our waffles and churros are fully customizable! Design your own "New Cute" look and create a flavor that’s uniquely yours ♡
Plus, this year’s packaging is super unique and fun—guaranteed to be Insta-worthy and a memory you’ll keep 😑 Become the ultimate trendsetter at MIF✨
【Waffles】
A festival-exclusive custom waffle made with "Elephant Ear" pastry 🐘! Pick your favorite toppings to build a masterpiece that’s all your own. You’ll also love the unique texture created by our signature prep method‼️
【Churros】
"Churro-ly" special for you😘✨
At MIF, we’ve got an interactive lineup where YOU get to craft your very own original churros!
Delicious‼️ Insta-Worthy‼️ Pure Fun‼️
You seriously HAVE to come check us out 🥹🥹
【Drinks】
Our signature drink: fizzy soda poured over a mountain of fresh fruit!
Sweet, tangy, and insanely photo-ready 🍹
Grab one to top off your festival memories‼️🥺

items.name: Media Creation Seminar Film Screening
items.description: Welcome to a powerful world of film created by junior high students! Be captivated by an expressive music video and two short dramas. Please come and join us in the Audio-Visual Room!
items.longDescription:
Welcome to the Media Creation Seminar! We are a group of 25 second- and third-year junior high students who handle every step of filmmaking ourselves—from planning and shooting to editing. At this year's MIF, we are screening three carefully crafted video projects as the culmination of our hard work!
The 2nd-year students present an ""Original Music Video"" that dynamically captures the atmosphere of the song. Keep an eye out for the fresh edit styles and creative direction born from young minds.
The 3rd-year students are screening ""Two Short Dramas"" developed entirely from scratch, including scriptwriting and casting. The highlight is the moving story that depicts the real struggles and bonds unique to junior high students.
Each work is packed with passion, bringing our vision of ""what we want to create"" to life. Come to the Audio-Visual Room to experience a unique cinematic space filled with our youth! We warmly look forward to seeing you there.

items.name: Underwater Adventure
items.description: Welcome to your underwater adventure! Hop aboard the submarine and set off on a grand adventure as you take aim at underwater targets and solve mysteries! Use your skills and ingenuity to aim for the highest score!
items.longDescription: Welcome to your journey to the ocean floor! You’ll hop aboard a mine cart and explore the ocean floor while following a set route. Use water guns and Nerf guns to hit the targets on the ocean floor and earn points. Plus, during your adventure, you might suddenly be asked ocean-related trivia questions! You’ll earn bonus points every time you answer correctly. It’s not just about aiming—quick thinking and knowledge are also the keys to a high score! Will you be able to conquer this underwater adventure...? If your final score exceeds a certain threshold, something special might be waiting for you...? Now, team up with your friends, aim for the highest score, and set off on a grand underwater adventure!

items.name: Ghost Bride
items.description: Trapped on her wedding day, the ghost of a bride haunts a cursed mansion. As you face the horrors hidden inside and search for her scattered wedding items, can you find them all? And what kind of wedding awaits at the end...?
items.longDescription:
A bride who died before she could ever have her wedding now wanders through a cursed mansion…

Scattered throughout the mansion are a ring, a bouquet, a veil, and other wedding items once belonging to the bride.

Why does the bride continue to wander through the mansion? And why were these wedding items left behind?

As you step into the mansion in search of answers, you will encounter spirits lurking in the darkness, sudden scares, and mysterious obstacles blocking your way.

Can you overcome your fears and find every item hidden throughout the mansion?

And what awaits you once you have found them all…?

The ending is yours to discover.

items.name: SEA BEAST 〜 Escape from the Depths〜
items.description: During a voyage at sea, your ship is attacked by an unknown creature called the “Sea Beast” and sinks. With the Sea Beast relentlessly chasing you and the time limit closing in, activate the emergency rescue boat and escape!
items.longDescription:
You are an adventurer traveling across the sea. During your voyage, your ship is attacked by a giant monster born from the garbage thrown into the ocean by humans. People call it the “Sea Beast.” The ship is badly damaged by the attack and begins to sink, leaving everyone in a life-threatening situation.
In the darkness of the sinking ship, the only way to return safely to the surface is to use the emergency rescue boat. However, the important items needed to activate the boat have been scattered throughout the ship, hidden in the darkness.
But the real terror starts here. As the darkness and rising water close in, the Sea Beast begins attacking again and again without giving you a moment to rest! With the relentless attacks coming from unpredictable directions and the time limit ticking away, can you overcome the Sea Beast’s terrifying pursuit and escape safely before time runs out?

items.name: S1D Special Mission: Space Station Infiltration & Recovery Operation
items.description: An immersive, interactive attraction where you’ll take on a series of missions to recover the blueprints for a cutting-edge spaceship stolen by a rival corporation!
items.longDescription:
A new planet rich in valuable resources has been discovered light-years from Earth. We were developing a cutting-edge spaceship to reach it, but our blueprints were suddenly stolen by a rival corporation!

In this interactive attraction, you become an agent tasked with completing a series of missions to recover the stolen blueprints. Featuring an intricately crafted storyline and immersive sets and production details, you will be drawn into a world unlike anything you’ve ever experienced

Put your skills and focus to the test, complete the missions, and save our company!

items.name: Escape the workplace
items.description: Participants take on the role of employees trapped in a toxic company and aim to resign while overcoming various missions and challenges. Through puzzles and mini-games that make use of the entire classroom, participants will work together with their friends and attempt to escape. This is an interactive, hands-on experience designed to allow participants to immerse themselves in the story.
items.longDescription:
Several missions are set up throughout the classroom, and participants collect the information and items necessary for their escape while completing these missions within the time limit.
The planned missions include mini-games such as moving luggage within a time limit, handling complaint calls, and target shooting. By completing each mission, participants can obtain numbers needed to solve codes, keys, and hints.
Using the information they have collected, participants solve the final puzzle. If they receive a “Resignation Letter” from their boss, they successfully escape. If they fail to escape within the time limit, they receive a “Resignation Failed” ending and proceed with the story by remaining in the toxic company.
Students participate by taking on roles such as employees and bosses, creating an immersive atmosphere. The goal is to create an interactive experience where visitors can enjoy themselves while taking on challenges.

items.name: Eclipse File
items.description: A murder took place on the night of a lunar eclipse. The killer is hiding among 32 people. Can you step into the role of a forensic investigator and uncover the truth?
items.longDescription:
Can You Solve the Case?
Welcome to S1F's interactive detective experience! In this event, you become a forensic investigator and work to identify the criminal behind a mysterious case.
You will visit three investigation stations—Hair Analysis, Fingerprint Collection, and Alibi Interviews—to gather clues and evidence. We will have a booth where visitors can experience what it is like to conduct a real forensic investigation!
By carefully examining the evidence, you must identify the culprit from among 32 suspects. Whether you solve the case depends on your observation skills, logical thinking, and detective instincts!
You are welcome to take on the challenge alone or work together with your friends and family. S1F are looking forward to seeing you!

items.name: Next Victims Wanted
items.description: Investigate a haunted house with a dark terrifying history from the 1990s. Your guide will lead you into the dark. The moment you notice something strange on the floor plan, the real terror begins. There is no way out.
items.longDescription:
Welcome... This is the haunted house you will be investigating today.
With only a floor map in your hands, you will step in to the suffocating dark and silent room filled with a terrifying atmosphere.
Every time you step forward, you will feel a chill run down your spine. From the darkness, a terrifying presence slowly draws near.
Trapped in a room with no way back, reality slowly appears around you. Something terrifying is hiding in the shadows, waiting for you.
Oh... have you noticed something strange?
Now, can you truly make it out of the abyssal dark of this cursed house?

items.name: Class 2-B Takoyaki Shop
items.description: Autumn Summer Fest! We've got takoyaki, baby castella, lemonade, and hot lemon drinks ready for you. S2B can't wait to see you all!
items.longDescription:
Blow away the autumn chill with an energy-packed "Summer Fest"! We’re bringing you all the vibrant electricity, fun, and lively atmosphere of a traditional summer festival that you rarely get to experience in the fall.

On the menu, we’ve got hot, crispy-on-the-outside, melt-in-your-mouth "Takoyaki" and bite-sized "Baby Castella" sponge cakes with a gentle sweetness that makes them the ultimate festival snack! To pair with your hot food, choose from refreshing, fizzy Lemon Squash, sweet and tangy Lemonade, or cozy Hot Lemon to warm you up on a cool autumn day.

Soak in the delicious aromas and the cheerful festival buzz. Why not spend an unforgettable time with your friends, family, or loved ones? We’re dedicated to giving every single visitor a giant smile and a boost of energy!

Come step into the absolute hottest spot at this year's autumn festival. All of us in Class 2-B can’t wait to see you there!

items.name: Karute wo karute
items.description: An abandoned hospital is covering up for medical accidents. You will become an investigator to solve the hidden chart within the heart monitor’s time limit and escape!
items.longDescription:
Become the "Hand that Hunts the Charts"—
This is a fully immersive horror escape attraction where you enter an abandoned hospital with a history of systematic medical cover-ups.
Your mission as an "investigator" is to uncover the hidden truth (evidence charts) and escape before time runs out. As the sound of a heart monitor echoes through the room to count down your final moments, you must decipher codes and solve mysteries hidden in the dark.
In the silent hospital room, all you can hear is the eerie heart monitor and the intense pressure of the ticking clock. The deeper you search, the more the hospital's terrifying darkness is revealed...
Can you overcome the rising fear, beat the clock, and uncover the hidden truth? We await your challenge, brave investigators!

items.name: Blessings Upon China
items.description: A Chinese restaurant where good fortune comes with every bite. Enjoy fried rice, soup dumplings, sesame balls, and a fortune slip inspired by the Chinese tradition of “qiuqian,” while discovering Chinese food culture and bringing a little luck your way.
items.longDescription: A Chinese restaurant inspired by Yokohama Chinatown, featuring a space decorated with a traditional-style gate and red lanterns. Enjoy three Chinese dishes—fried rice, soup dumplings, and sesame balls—along with fortune slips inspired by the Chinese tradition of “qiuqian.” Trivia about Chinese food culture is featured on the menu and fortune slips, allowing visitors to discover Chinese culture while enjoying their food. Eat Chinese food, learn about the culture, and draw your fortune. It is a restaurant filled with food, fun, learning, and good luck.

items.name: Are you smarter than S2E?
items.description: Parodies of famous quiz shows, packed with unique challenges! Test your knowledge, wit, and luck across a variety of quiz types. Are you smarter than us?
items.longDescription:
Step into a quiz game inspired by some of the most famous quiz shows around!
Take on a variety of quiz formats, from parodies of familiar game shows to completely original quizzes that you won’t find anywhere else. Knowledge isn’t always enough, you’ll need quick thinking, good judgment, memory, and sometimes even a little luck to come out on top.
Each quiz comes with its own rules, challenges, and surprises, giving you a different experience every time you play. Your strongest subjects, unexpected knowledge, or even a lucky guess could be the key to victory.
So, do you think you’re smarter than us? Come test it.
Take on every quiz, prove what you know, and try to get a perfect score!

items.name: Base camp S2F
items.description: Enjoy classic camping treats like s’mores, hot or iced chocolate, and hot sandwiches! You can experience the warm and special atmosphere of camping here at “Base
items.longDescription: Welcome to “Base Camp S2F”! We offer a variety of camp-themed snacks. You can enjoy classic camping treats: s’mores, hot chocolate with marshmallow toppings, and hot sandwiches. Beyond the food, we also aim to recreate the excitement of camping, where everyone works together to create the perfect campsite. For our hot sandwiches, we will use bread from “はーとあーすの手作りパン屋さん”, and through this collaboration, you also can discover the connection between the local community and social welfare. Come visit “Base Camp S2F” and enjoy the warm atmosphere of camping!

items.name: MITA Natural History Museum
items.description: In this project, we will present results of investigations on wildlife in campus, display specimens, and hold quizzes in order to help visitors learn more about local fauna and flora.
items.longDescription:
The main focus is an exhibition of the results of an investigation of the school’s vegetation and ecology. Mita International School of Science is one of the few private secondary schools in Tokyo that are surrounded by a lush natural environment and home to diverse wildlife. Unfortunately, many students and faculty do not pay much attention to this world – they have simply grown accustomed to it as mere “scenery.” This project aims to spread interest in this flora and fauna. This event will also show the changes that have occurred over the past 25 years ago based on nature records compiled during the school’s time as Toita Gakuen.
We will also be holding a quiz contest. Participants will be asked to identify camouflaged wildlife from photographs with four tiers of difficulty : “Beginner”, “Intermediate”, “Advanced”, and even “Brutal”. Please feel free to give it a try at any time! If you happen to find the animal within the time limit, you can display your initials.
Lastly, we will also be showcasing activities by our organization and specimens owned by our members, so feel free to stop by and take a look!
We are looking forward to seeing you!

items.name: 3 Days in a Shelter: Escape! Learning Disaster Preparedness Through Food
items.description: One day, an earthquake struck out of the blue—. What would you think and how would you act at an evacuation shelter? Experience three days of life in an evacuation shelter!
items.longDescription:
On the day a disaster struck, you found yourself heading to an evacuation shelter—.

In “Evacuation Shelter 3 Days: Escape! Learning Disaster Preparedness Through Food,” set in an evacuation shelter recreated out of cardboard, visitors take on the role of evacuees and experience three days spent in the shelter, starting immediately after the disaster strikes.

With limited supplies, ever-changing circumstances, and “food” as the lifeline of evacuation life, visitors will have fun learning about food during disasters through quizzes and hands-on activities. Plus, there will be opportunities to actually see and taste a variety of emergency rations…?

How would you spend these three days?

items.name: Fiesta Night Market
items.description: Enjoy international street food and cultural experiences while spending time with friends and family at our welcoming night market. The cafeteria can also be used not only to enjoy the FIESTA event, but also as a place to eat food brought from elsewhere, take a break, or relax and chat with friends.
items.longDescription: FIESTA Night Market World Food Stalls is an international cultural event where visitors can experience the flavors and atmosphere of night markets from around the world！Through international foods, themed decorations, and music, we aim to create an atmosphere inspired by night markets around the world.In addition to enjoying international food, visitors can learn about the cultures and traditions of different countries and regions through informational displays and cultural exhibits. The cafeteria can also be used by visitors who wish to bring food and drinks from elsewhere, take a break, or spend time chatting and relaxing with friends.Whether you come to enjoy international food, explore different cultures, or simply spend time with friends and family, we hope FIESTA Night Market will provide a fun and welcoming space where everyone can enjoy food, conversation, and cultural experiences. We look forward to seeing you there!

items.name: Mission : Tsunagari Palace
items.description: Not confident in your English? No problem! Try being a tour guide for a day!
items.longDescription: Try being an Imperial Palace tour guide for a day! Practice translating Japanese descriptions into English while guiding our staff, who will play the role of foreign tourists. You can choose your own difficulty level, or just read from a prepared script if translating feels too hard. Complete all the missions to win a prize, and try the bonus challenge to get an extra reward!

items.name: Choco Craft
items.description: Let’s find and harvest cocoa pods and make a traditional Ghanaian instrument! Through fun games and crafts, participants can discover the secrets of chocolate and learn about the world.
items.longDescription: This is an interactive workshop where participants can learn about the world through the story of cocoa, the main ingredient of chocolate. First, participants will learn about how cocoa is grown and processed into chocolate. Then, they will search for and harvest cocoa pods from a handmade cocoa tree in the classroom. Inside each cocoa pod, they will find materials to make an “Asalato (Batika),” a traditional Ghanaian instrument. Participants will also choose a coloed ball based on what they think children in cocoa-producing regions need, such as love, education, jobs, or basic necessities. Through finding, making, and thinking, participants can have fun while learning about cocoa production and social issues such as child labor and poverty. This activity is designed for everyone from young children to adults.

items.name: MISSION: POWER RESTORE
items.description: Restore a school that has been hit by a power outage using floor-based electricity generation! Generate power by stepping on energy-harvesting floors to light up LEDs, and take on quiz challenges in an interactive mission that lets you have fun while learning about renewable energy.
items.longDescription: Welcome to MISSION: POWER RESTORE! The school has been plunged into a blackout, and it’s up to you to save it. Use energy-harvesting floor panels to generate electricity and take on a variety of missions! As you clear quizzes, LED lights will turn on one by one, gradually restoring power throughout the school. Experience real energy-harvesting technology while having fun and learning about energy. Work together with your friends to bring light back to the darkened school!

items.name: MIF International Room
items.description: Celebrate Mita's "international" character!
items.longDescription: The international room is a space where teachers, staff, and students celebrate the blend of backgrounds that makes Mita unique. Please come and enjoy our displays and workshops spanning all the inhabited continents of the world.

items.name: Stroller safekeeping
items.description: We will look after your stroller while you are visiting the school. Please come to Entrance/exit
items.longDescription:
We offer all-day stroller storage so that everyone can enjoy MIF with peace of mind.
We are also happy to answer any other questions you may have.

items.name: School Uniform Fitting Experience
items.description: Try on our official school uniform and take a commemorative photo! You can also chat with student council members and get a firsthand taste of life as a Mita International student.
items.longDescription:
In this activity, prospective students and visitors are invited to try on our school uniform. You can choose either the summer or winter uniform according to your preference. By experiencing the design and comfort for yourself, you can get a clearer picture of your future student life here.
After trying on the uniform, you can take a commemorative photo either by yourself or together with your family to create a wonderful memory of your visit.
Please note that numbered tickets may be distributed if the event becomes crowded. If you wish to participate, please register at the reception in advance.
We hope that putting on our uniform will help turn any anxiety about entrance exams into hope for the future. We look forward to welcoming you!

items.name: Book&Loop ~Connect with books, connect to the future~
items.description: With books and the environment as the themes, this project upcycles used clothing, plastic bottles, and pinecones. It’s an initiative that lets participants experience the joy of reading and the importance of taking good care of things.
items.longDescription: “BOOK & LOOP” is an event designed to convey the appeal of reading while offering a fun way to experience the SDGs that the Library Committee is working to promote. In addition to selling our original bookmarks—which were a hit last year—we will be selling book covers and keychains made from unwanted used clothing collected on campus. We will also be giving away free handmade kendamas made from recycled plastic bottles and upcycled pinecones we’ve collected, allowing visitors to experience “upcycling”—the process of transforming everyday items into something new and valuable. Furthermore, through an “Recommended Books Exhibition” curated by the Library Committee, we will create unique, once-in-a-lifetime encounters between visitors and books. Under this year’s theme, “Eclipse,” we aim to foster new connections between objects, books, and people.

items.name: Pop Dance Club 2026 MIF Performance -Epilogue-
items.description: A five-month culmination created by 140 dancers. With “Epilogue” as our theme, we present a special performance that marks the closing of one chapter of our club.
items.longDescription: For the Pop Dance Club, the Cultural Festival is our biggest event of the year, and we spend approximately five months preparing for it. This year’s theme, “Epilogue,” represents the end of one chapter and the beginning of the next. Through a variety of dance genres, our 140 members will showcase their individuality, passion, and the unity we have built throughout the year. With the energy and impact of such a large group, we hope to share our love for dance and create a memorable experience for everyone involved. For the senior year, this is their final performance, while for the other grades, it marks the end of our current club structure and the beginning of a new chapter.
items.ticketInfo: A ticket is required for entry. Please note that there will be no ticket distribution on the day of the event.

items.name: “Next to you again”
items.description: This is a heartwarming story about young game creators who clash over on their project, confront the feelings they have kept inside, and find their way back to the bonds they once shared.
items.longDescription:
A group of high school students are working on a game for a competition. However, differences in their ideas and the things they care about gradually create tension within the team. Their struggles are made even more complicated by past friendships and a senior member who is struggling with the responsibilities of being a leader. As a result, the development of their game doesn't go as smoothly as they had hoped.
Even so, they each take the time to face their own feelings and work together to complete their game. Filled with laughter, conflicts, and heartwarming moments, this is a story about friendship, growth, and the bonds between teammates.
What kind of game will they create, and what result will await them in the end?
Come to the Main Hall and see their journey for yourself!

items.name: Chorus Club MIF Performance 2026
items.description: We are excited to share the beauty of choral music with you! From traditional choral pieces to J-POP, we will perform a wide variety of songs. Please come and enjoy our performance in the Audio-Visual Room!
items.longDescription: The Chorus Club will perform in the Audio-Visual Room on the first floor! Our program features sophisticated choral pieces performed at the NHK National School Music Competition, showcasing rich harmonies and delicate musical expressions created by each individual voice. We will also perform familiar J-POP songs that you may know and love! Experience both the rich resonance unique to choral music and the familiar, catchy melodies that may make you want to sing along. We hope you enjoy a wonderful time filled with music and our voices!

items.name: Rhythmic Gymnastics Club Performance
items.description: We will present a rhythmic gymnastics performance inspired by Studio Ghibli’s masterpiece Princess Mononoke. Using skills and apparatus unique only to rhythmic gymnastics, we will bring the world of Princess Mononoke to life.
items.longDescription:
Our Rhythmic Gymnastics Club will present a performance inspired by Studio Ghibli and Hayao Miyazaki’s timeless masterpiece, Princess Mononoke, at the Main Hall on both days!
Using rhythmic gymnastics techniques, apparatus, and stage props, we will bring to life the magnificent world of Princess Mononoke, which portrays the coexistence of nature and humanity.
In addition to the main performance, we will also showcase competitive routines, each filled with the individual creativity, passion, and dedication of our members. We hope to share our own interpretation of this beloved story, which has captivated audiences not only in Japan but worldwide. We will give it our all to create a performance that everyone can enjoy. We look forward to seeing you there!

items.name: English Debate and Model UN Showcase
items.description: English Club presents the yearly English debate showcase and the Model UN session! Experience the intensity of speeches and the excitement of international negotiation!
items.longDescription:
English Club will present Model United Nations (MUN) on Day 1 and English Debate on Day 2!

【Day 1: Model United Nations (MUN)】
Club members representing different countries will demonstrate realtime negotiation and decision making on global issues. Visitors can also participate by voting on draft resolutions.

【Day 2: English Debate】
Members will engage in an impromptu English debate on an assigned topic. With interactive audience segments and Japanese summary support provided, non-native speakers can enjoy the debate.

Experience the world of MUN & Debate through our passionate performances!

items.name: Flower of Koto
items.description: Enjoy the beautiful sounds of the koto, a traditional Japanese instrument, performed by the Koto Club. Each member will put their heart into the performance and do their very best!
items.longDescription: The Koto Club will perform four pieces: “さくら,” “さんさんさくら,” “街の朝,” and “ひぐらし.” Between the performances, we will introduce each piece and have quizzes about the koto and the music. We hope you will enjoy not only listening to the music, but also learning about the koto and Japanese traditional culture through the quizzes. We will do our very best, so please enjoy the performance until the end!

items.name: Harmony in the Sky ~2026 Wind Orchestra Concert~
items.description: Enjoy an exciting performance by more than 120 musicians! With a variety of songs and fun stage performances, we will bring the world of the sky to life through music.
items.longDescription:
The Mita International School Wind Orchestra, also known as “Mitasui,” will perform at this year’s MIF with more than 120 musicians.
We will play a variety of music, from powerful and energetic songs to beautiful and moving melodies. Please also enjoy the performers’ movements and special stage effects between songs. Please do come and experience the power and beauty of music with us!
(Please note: This performance requires a ticket. Guests without a ticket cannot enter. Tickets will be available at the venue on the day of the event.)
items.ticketInfo:
Tickets are strictly required. Same-day tickets are available for outside visitors only.

Ticket Distribution Info
Day 1
Location: Ground
Time: From 2:50 PM

Day 2
Location: Hall Building Corridor
Time: From 9:00 AM

items.name: Experiencing Shogi and Chess
items.description: Visitors can enjoy playing Chess and Shogi. We will confirm your skill level upon entry, so everyone, whether you have played it before or not, can have a great time.
items.longDescription:
At our event, we will ask about your experience, rank, or rating in Chess and Shogi upon entry, and guide you to a club member of a similar skill level.
We hope you can get a feel of our club's atmosphere while enjoying the actual Chess or Shogi matches. We also hope this experience will help train your critical and creative thinking through the match.
Whether you are a beginner or an experienced player, we look forward to welcoming you!

items.name: Kombu Observation Island — The Cradle of Electrons —
items.description: At our booth, you can view and experience our works which contains videos, video games, songs, and 3D models. Enjoy our world of the “Cradle of Electronics”!
items.longDescription:
Our booth features four types of hands-on activities and two types of exhibits.
The four hands-on activities are as follows:
- Vocaloid Songs Experience
- Avatar Interaction Experience
- VTuber Experience
- Studio Experience

The two exhibits are as follows:
- Exhibition of Individual Works
- Concept Posters

The sight of club members—who are usually engaged in various individual activities—collaborating toward a common goal called MIF is truly reminiscent of the celestial alignment evoked by this year’s theme “Eclipse.”

The subtitle, “Cradle of Electronics,” derives from Computer Club’s nickname, “Combu,” which is often referred to as the “cradle of the sea.”

We hope you enjoy our unique world of the “Cradle of Electronics”!

items.name: Science Club 2026 —The Glowing Galaxy Slime—
items.description: This year's theme is the glowing slime! Let’s explore the free spirited experiment of the Mita International School of Science!
items.longDescription: Hello, everyone! We are the Science Club! Every year, we organize fun, easy, and safe hands-on activities to help you experience the wonders of science up close. This year, we are excited to invite you to make your very own glowing slime! While you wait, you can also enjoy our special exhibits featuring air cannons and parachutes. The activity takes about 30 minutes. To ensure everyone's safety and avoid overcrowding, we will be distributing numbered tickets in front of the lab as soon as the doors open. There will be 4 sessions in total (2 in the morning and 2 in the afternoon), limited to 20 participants per session. All of us at the Science Club are looking forward to seeing you. Please come and join the fun!

items.name: Japanese Tea Ceremony
items.description: Come and enjoy matcha & Japanese sweets while watching a traditional tea ceremony performance? Our annual tea gathering, hosted by the Tea Ceremony Club and always a favorite among visitors, will be held again this year!
items.longDescription:
The tea master and assistant will be dressed in traditional Japanese attire (kimono) and demonstrate the Omotesenke style of tea preparation, which they have diligently practiced during their club activities. Guests will be served traditional Japanese sweets and matcha tea. Please come and enjoy this peaceful and welcoming atmosphere of Japanese hospitality!
Location: Japanese room on the 2nd floor of the classroom building 
Time: Three tea gatherings will be held each afternoon on both days.
Please Note: Advance ticket purchase is required. Be sure to check the ticket sales start times listed below. Tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis and sell out very quickly every year, so we strongly recommend lining up early!

② Tea Gathering: 13:30–14:10  Ticket Sales Begin: 13:10
③ Tea Gathering: 14:30–15:10  Ticket Sales Begin: 14:10

items.name: Polaris
items.description: In conjunction with this year's MIF theme, we will hold a poster exhibition, a display of train parts, and an N-gauge model train operating experience, all centered on the theme of sleeper trains named after celestial bodies.
items.longDescription:
Poster Exhibition
We will display posters featuring trains that continue to operate—such as the Sunrise Izumo/Seto, WEST EXPRESS Ginga, and Luna Azul—as well as trains that have already been retired, such as the Hokutosei and Cassiopeia.

Display of Parts and Tickets
We will exhibit an actual car-number plate from the 581 series sleeper train, which once connected Ueno and the Tohoku region. Other exhibits will include tickets and parts from non-sleeper train models.

Train Operation Experience
Visitors will have the opportunity to operate N-gauge model trains.

items.name: Let’s try Ikebana!
items.description: Visitors can choose their favorite flowers and enjoy a hands-on ikebana experience. They can also look at the beautiful arrangements thoughtfully created by members of the Ikebana Club.
items.longDescription: This project allows visitors to choose their favorite fresh flowers and experience authentic ikebana together with members of the Ikebana Club. Even first-time participants can join with confidence, as our members will carefully guide them through the basics of flower arrangement. By using real fresh flowers, visitors can enjoy their natural fragrance, vibrant colors, and seasonal beauty while discovering the charm of ikebana. Participants can also take their completed arrangements home as a memorable keepsake from the school festival and display them there. After the hands-on experience, visitors are invited to view the ikebana works created by our club members, each expressing a unique style and creativity. This combination of creating and appreciating ikebana offers a deeper understanding of this traditional Japanese art. We look forward to welcoming you to our booth! 💐

items.name: Art Club
items.description: This year, we are featuring staircase art inspired by this year’s MIF theme, “Eclipse,” along with objects and works created by our club members, as well as selling MIF-exclusive merchandise.
items.longDescription: At the entrance hall, enjoy our staircase art themed "Eclipse." Next to the art room, take photos with our "Rocket" object, MIF's sub-motif. We sell MIF-exclusive keychains, pottery, and Mejirushi Charm keychains. Inside, enjoy our club exhibition and try stencil-dyeing coasters and pouches. We look forward to welcoming you and hope you enjoy your visit.

items.name: Takurips
items.description: Join our interactive event! After learning table tennis basics, test your skills against the club members using fun items like serving trays as rackets!
items.longDescription: Learn the basics of table tennis from our club members, then test your skills in an exciting match! To level the playing field, our members will use fun household items—like serving trays—instead of real paddles, so even total beginners have a great chance to win. Think you can beat them in a serious match? Winners get a special little prize! Everyone is welcome, so come enjoy table tennis, make great memories, and join the fun at our school festival!

items.name: MITA Tennis Club Experience
items.description: You can see how the members of MITA Tennis Club practices, encourages, and cooperates with each other. You can also try playing tennis.
items.longDescription: In this activity, you can actually try playing tennis and see how Mita students take the lead. In addition, MITA Tennis Club values personal growth. Therefore, we make sure to give greetings and responses in a clear and lively voice. This experience allows you to learn the importance of personal growth through tennis, as well as the joy of playing sports with friends.

items.name: Volleyball
items.description: You can experience playing volleyball with our volleyball club members using soft volleyballs! No prior experience is necessary! Come join us and have fun passing the ball and keeping it in the air!
items.longDescription:
This is an interactive activity where you can try and learn basic volleyball skills with our volleyball club members using soft volleyballs. Participants will pair up with our club members and practice simple passing drills while chatting and having fun.

Everyone is welcome, including beginners, young children, and those who are not confident in sports. Our club members will support you step by step, so please feel free to join us!

We have also prepared seats for parents right next to the activity area, so parents can comfortably watch their children while they participate.

By passing the ball to each other and communicating with our club members, you can experience the fun of playing volleyball and the sense of accomplishment that comes from keeping the ball going together.

We are looking forward to seeing those who are interested in volleyball or sports in general, or simply want to get some exercise while waiting in line. Come join us and have some fun!

*Please note that each session is limited to 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, all participants must leave the activity area so that the next group can participate. Continuous participation is not allowed.

items.name: LET’S Track and Field!!
items.description: Experience five track and field events—50m sprint, long jump, high jump, javelic ball, and hurdles—with your performance measured, and have fun!
items.longDescription: At “LET’S Track and Field!,” you can try five track and field events: the 50m sprint, hurdles, long jump, high jump, and javelic ball! In the 50m sprint, your time will be measured and displayed on an electronic scoreboard. Your jump height, jump distance, and throwing distance will also be measured. The highlight of this project is that you can experience track and field events that you do not usually get to try. Have fun running, jumping, and throwing while challenging your own records! Everyone who completes all five events will receive a prize. Whether you are good at sports or not, everyone is welcome!

items.name: PTA (Food, Sweets, Drinks, and Merchandise)
items.description: A day that fills both your stomach and your heart. Food, sweets, drinks, and merchandise — all at the PTA booth.
items.longDescription:
The MIF favorites are back again this year — plus new Korean street food and a fresh lineup of original Mita merchandise!
- Meat-wrapped rice balls, bulgogi kimbap, yangnyeom chicken, yakitori skewers, savory breads, and popcorn
- Assorted drinks
- MIF original sweets (cookies, pound cake, financiers, candy, dorayaki)
- Mita original merchandise (phone straps, bottle holders, LED wristbands, ballpoint pens, cotton bags, Imabari mini towels, opera glasses, and more)

The MIF favorites are back again this year — plus new Korean street food and a fresh lineup of original Mita merchandise!
- Meat-wrapped rice balls, bulgogi kimbap, yangnyeom chicken, yakitori skewers, savory breads, and popcorn

items.name: Team PaPa MITA DOG
items.description: Team PaPa is back with MIF’s famous “MITA DOG”! This year, enjoy our hot dogs with 100% rice-flour, gluten-free buns and exciting toppings inspired by flavors from around the world!
items.longDescription:
MITA DOG, MIF’s famous hot dog, is back again this year!

Following last year’s success, we’re bringing you even more exciting toppings inspired by flavors from around the world.

Choose any three of our 15+ carefully selected toppings and create your very own one-of-a-kind MITA DOG!

Classic: Hot dog with our special sausage
Popular: Gluten-free hot dog with a 100% rice-flour bun
Customize It: Choose from 15+ toppings inspired by flavors from around the world

items.name: MITA International School of Science Kouenkai
items.group: MITA International School of Science Kouenkai
items.description: Kouenkai will once again be selling "Kouenkai Yakisoba" and "Mitarashii Dango" this year. They will be offering yakisoba with their special sauce and mitarashi dango (a specialty of mitarashi).
items.longDescription:
Once again, the Mita International School of Science Kouenkai will be selling its signature "Kouenkai Yakisoba" and "Mitarashii Dango" (a play on words combining "Mitarashi"and "Mita-rashii") at Kouenkai tent as a special MIF exclusive.
The "Kouenkai Yakisoba" has become a staple of the MIF, selling 900 servings a day. We take pride in our original sauce and carefully selected ingredients, serving up freshly cooked, handmade portions. Also available is the "Mitarashii Dango,""introduced last year; these unique dumplings feature the mitarashi glaze inside, making them easy to eat by hand. They are the perfect snack to satisfy a light hunger, offering a heartwarming, cozy treat.
We invite everyone to come and enjoy these classic MIF flavors. Members of the Association—comprising parents of graduates—look forward to serving you their handmade creations.

items.name: Chigusakai Room
items.description: A space where alumni can share fond memories and reconnect with one another. Please stop by!
items.longDescription: A space where alumni can share fond memories and reconnect with one another. Please stop by!

items.name: Student Work Display
items.description: This exhibition showcases the creativity and diverse learning experiences of our students. You will see how MITA encourages the development of free thinkers.
items.longDescription: This exhibition showcases the creativity and diverse learning experiences of our students. You will see how MITA encourages the development of free thinkers. You can see our lessons and the students' learning closely. We will display not only the work products (posters, creations) but also the teaching materials and textbooks used in lessons.

items.name: Introductory Seminar and Basic Research Presentations
items.group: MIF Executive Committee, Planning and Administration Division, Basic Seminar, Basic Research Group
items.description: This is a presentation of the results of basic research and basic seminars led by students as part of their school life. Please stop by—even if just for a few minutes!
items.longDescription:
This event features presentations of the results from basic research and basic seminars led by students as part of their school life.
It showcases the findings from the basic seminars, where middle school students conduct research in groups organized by theme, as well as the basic research projects undertaken by high school MSTC students on topics aligned with their interests.
We’ve prepared a variety of presentation formats, including poster presentations and oral presentations, creating a space where we can explore these questions further together with our visitors. We’d love it if you’d feel free to ask questions or strike up a conversation about any presentations that catch your interest!
Of course, we’re also happy to talk about school life in general, not just research activities! Please feel free to stop by!

items.name: MSTC Student Research Presentations
items.description: MSTC students will present their ongoing research through poster and oral presentations.
items.longDescription: MSTC students will give oral presentations on the research they work on throughout the year. Their research covers a wide range of topics, including culturing microorganisms and searching for substances that may lead to new medicines, designing and building various robots, simulating how the brain works, exploring whether mushrooms might communicate with each other, and investigating how substances in the human body are related to diseases. There is a lot of exciting research to discover!

items.name: Personal Presentation
items.description: The theme for the first-year junior high school students is "Self-Understanding." Each student will give a presentation. Please look forward to seeing them express their true, relatable selves.
items.longDescription: During their first six months at MITA, students have looked deeply within themselves through the orientation camp and Integrated Studies classes. They reflected on their past using lifeline charts, mapped out their core values on the 'Big Tree,' and searched for their true center. In addition, by interviewing one another, they discovered their strengths and weaknesses, analyzing both the 'self they know' and the 'self others see.' With this foundation, they have now turned their eyes toward the future—visualizing their ideal selves, mapping out their dreams, and setting goals to achieve them. Bringing together everything they have learned, they are now ready to take on the challenge of a seven-minute presentation.

items.name: Career Presentation (Junior High School Year 1)
items.group: Junior High first grade Representative Presentation
items.description: With the theme of “Self-Understanding,” student representatives from each class and course will share presentations reflecting on what they have learned about themselves.
items.longDescription: During their first six months at MITA, our first-year junior high school students have explored who they are through the Orientation Camp and Integrated Studies classes, deepening their self-understanding. By creating Life Line Charts and Big Trees and interviewing their classmates, they have reflected on their values, strengths, and areas for growth while thinking about their future selves. At this event, student representatives selected from each class and course will deliver presentations showcasing their learning. Students in the ISC Standard classes will present in Japanese, while students in the ISC Intermediate and Advanced classes and the IC program will present in English. We invite you to experience the genuine thoughts, growth, and aspirations of our first-year junior high school students.

items.name: Career Presentation (High School Year 1)
items.group: High School First Grade Representative Presentation
items.description: With the theme of “Future Vision,” student representatives selected from each class and course will present their career aspirations and visions for the future.
items.longDescription: Over the past three years at MITA, our first-year high school students have continuously explored their own careers through career education, residential programs, and Integrated Studies classes. Building on these experiences, they have redefined their personal career paths and reflected more deeply on their future vision, the lives they hope to lead, and the ways they wish to contribute to society. At this event, student representatives selected from each class and course will share presentations on their future visions and aspirations. Students in the ISC and MSTC programs will present in Japanese, while students in the IC program will present in English. We invite you to discover the passion, ambition, and future aspirations of our first-year high school students.

items.name: Mini Junior High School Information Session
items.description: Discover the unique educational approach and student life at Mita International Science Academy Junior High School, where we strive to nurture creative thinkers, in this 30-minute information session.
items.longDescription:
Mini Junior High School Information Session (Approx. 30 minutes)

Join our 30-minute Mini Junior High School Information Session, designed for elementary school students and their parents who are considering applying to Mita International Science Academy Junior High School.

We will introduce the distinctive features of our school, including our educational philosophy of fostering "Creative Thinkers", inquiry-based learning, English education, science and ICT programs, and student life.

If you are wondering, "What is the school like?" or "What kind of students study here?", this session will give you a clear picture of our learning environment and school community.

Whether you are actively considering applying or are simply interested in learning more about our school, we warmly welcome you to join us. We look forward to seeing you at our Mini Junior High School Information Session!

items.name: MSTC Representative Presentations
items.description: Selected MSTC students present their research findings.
items.longDescription: Each grade selects one outstanding research project from the work MSTC students carry out throughout the year, and the selected students give an oral presentation. This is a special once-a-year opportunity for them to share the excitement and enjoyment of their research. We hope you will come and see their presentations!

items.name: Recitation and Speech in English
items.description: This event features presentations by students in J1 through S2 who achieved outstanding results in the English Speech and Recitation Contest at school, as well as presentations by students returning from long-term study abroad!
items.longDescription: At our school, we cultivate students’ ability to express their thoughts in English through classes and school events. As part of this effort, we hold an annual English Recitation and Speech Contest.In the recitation category, students practice honing their public speaking skills while developing a natural feel for authentic English. In the speech category, students express their own thoughts in their own words on issues facing modern society and learn techniques to better engage their audience.In high school, in addition to the Speech Division, students hone more advanced presentation skills through a project called “Ignite Talk.”At the school-wide contest, representatives selected from each class give presentations, and students from 7th to 11th grade who achieved outstanding results will present at this event. On the day of the event, we also hope you will enjoy presentations by students returning from long-term study abroad programs about their experiences overseas.Please come and witness the students’ daily efforts and growth!

items.name: Campus Tour
items.description: Our MITA students will provide a tour of the whole school from students’ points of view. Want to get a glimpse of the real MITA? Come see what you can only experience here!!!
items.longDescription: We will be doing campus tours again this year, thanks to the positive reactions from visitors. Each tour will be about 15 minutes, with a student guide who will guide you around the whole campus. You are free and even encouraged to ask questions and have the opportunity to listen to students’ own experiences at MITA, which are often very interesting, such as learning about kids’ daily school lives here and hearing entertaining stories from them. Our team is very excited to meet our future Kohais, and we cannot wait to see you!!

items.name: Admissions Consultation Room
items.description: Find exam information and ask about classes and school life at MITA!
items.longDescription: Find exam information and ask about classes and school life at MITA!

items.name: Cafeteria Food Service
items.description: Rice dishes such as donburi(rice bowls) and curry, snack sales including karaage(fried chicken), collaborative sales planned with students, etc.
items.longDescription:
We sell a wide variety of rice dishes, snacks, and more.
This year, we well jointly sell items planned together with students.
Please stop by!
